sloka: ततः सुमाली माली च श्रुत्वा माल्यवतो वचः ।ऊचतुर्भ्रातरं ज्येष्ठं भगांशाविव वासवम् ।। ७.६.३९ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ sumālī mālī ca śrutvā mālyavato vacaḥ ।ūcaturbhrātaraṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ bhagāṁśāviva vāsavam ।। 7.6.39 ॥

translations.english: Knowing that these very beings were slain by Narayana in hundreds and thousands, you should now grant forgiveness to all of them here.
